topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how Darwinian selection acts on genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations to drive clonal expansion in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cellular hierarchy and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of the cell of origin and evaluate evidence for cancer stem cells across hematological and solid tissue models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how external stimuli, inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with mutations to promote and maintain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for mapping tumor evolution and microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the sequencing, imaging, and computational technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated model of multifactorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic for the subsequent session.
